mods.name: TNT Optimiser
mods.description: Reduces server-side CPU cost of large TNT chain reactions. Vanilla's per-explosion ray-cast scan is replaced by a breadth-first traversal that visits each block in the blast sphere once and de-duplicates work across overlapping explosions in the same tick. Explosion radius, entity damage and knockback are unchanged; the exact set of destroyed blocks may differ slightly from vanilla's ray-cast crater by design.

releases.notes:
TNT Optimiser — 26.1.2

Add BFS-based block scanning for TNT explosions — each block visited exactly once per explosion instead of vanilla's repeated ray-cast scan
Add cross-explosion deduplication — overlapping blast zones in a chain reaction skip re-scanning shared blocks via a per-tick tracker
Zero added overhead for isolated TNT — single explosions with no neighbours fire on vanilla's fast path
Blast radius, damage, and knockback unchanged
Server-side only, no client install required
Note: crater shape may differ slightly from vanilla's ray-cast pattern due to the BFS scanning change; radius/damage/knockback are not affected

Requirements: Minecraft 26.1.2 · Fabric Loader 0.19.3+ · Fabric API 0.155.2+26.1.2

readmeSummary: A Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.1.2 that reduces the server-side CPU cost of large TNT chain reactions, without changing the explosion radius, entity damage or knockback.
